prompt:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic devotional oil painting video clip, controlled pacing with deliberate cuts and extended holds.

Classical devotional oil painting realism. atmosphere of an open invitation to the thirsty to come and drink; visible brushwork, craquelure, aged varnish throughout.

Scene contains:
an opened spring risen from dry ground at the edge of a parched land, thirsting figures of every kind gathered near with empty vessels, a child, an old man, a bowed woman, all drawn toward the clear water, subtle background vignettes fading into shadow suggesting cracked ground drinking the water, new green shoots at the water's edge, empty waterpots held out, and a far wilderness behind. The scene is a painted tableau — a frozen moment, not an action. Nothing moves; this is a still painting.

Scene:
Start on full composition — the whole painted scene.

Cut to mid framing — the dominant subject of the painting.

Cut to close-up — the risen spring.

Cut to insert — the cracked drinking ground.

Cut to macro detail — the new green shoots.

Cut to lower framing — the held-out empty vessel.

Return to full composition.

End hold on the risen spring.

Micro-motion:
- minimal

Camera:
- crop-based reframing only
- no invented movement

Emotion:
an open invitation to the thirsty

No added elements.
